syllabus_topics: Definition and examples of vector spaces
Kernel and image of a linear transformation
Solution space of a linear equation
Examples of applications (e.g. systems of linear ordinary differential equations with constant coefficients, stability of linear dynamical systems, Markov chains, PageRank algorithm)
Singular value decomposition of a transformation between Euclidean spaces

assessment_methods.method: 5 online quizzes (can substitute one MAP45 score)

assessment_rules: The provisional final grade (NF) is the maximum of the average of the three MAP45 tests or the recovery exam (E), rounded to the nearest integer. The score of a MAP45 can be substituted by a better recovery MAP45 score. If a student does not attend a MAP45 or exam, the score for that component counts as 0. Approval requires a final classification of >= 10. For a provisional NF > 17, an optional oral exam can be taken, otherwise the final score will be 17.
